entries.content: New main site classes KD (Kleinflaeche digital) and FD (Flag digital). Main site class SP (Superposter) removed.
New construction types (Bauarten) S1 and S2.

Digital sub site classes SD and ED under main site class GF, on a decade rhythm, with a committed 10-second spot per minute. Product exclusions for election advertising. A mail address is to be held for the dispatch address.
WGS84 coordinates introduced, in the format 99.999999999999. The earlier MIA coordinate fields are retained alongside them.
